import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final long INF = (long)1e18;
    static int R, C;
    static String S;
    static long[][] comb = new long[61][61];

    static class Pair {
        long first;
        int second;
        Pair(long first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    static List<Pair>[] dpL = new ArrayList[31];
    static List<Pair>[] dpR = new ArrayList[31];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 31; i++) {
            dpL[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            dpR[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static long calc(String t) {
        long ans = 0;
        int a = 0, b = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < t.length(); i++) {
            if (t.charAt(i) == 'A') {
                a++;
                ans += (comb[a][R] - comb[a - 1][R]) * (comb[R + C][R] - comb[b][R]);
            } else {
                b++;
                ans -= (comb[b][R] - comb[b - 1][R]) * (comb[R + C][R] - comb[a][R]);
            }
        }
        if (a != b) return INF;
        return ans;
    }

    static boolean match(String t) {
        for (int i = 0; i < S.length(); i++) {
            if (!(S.charAt(i) == '?' || S.charAt(i) == t.charAt(i))) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static void init() throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
        R = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
        C = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
        S = br.readLine();

        comb[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 61; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
                comb[i][j] = comb[i - 1][j];
                if (j > 0) comb[i][j] += comb[i - 1][j - 1];
            }
        }
    }

    static void dfsL(int ind, int a, int b, int mask, long p) {
        if (ind == C + 1) {
            dpL[a].add(new Pair(p, mask));
            return;
        }
        dfsL(ind + 1, a + 1, b, mask ^ (1 << ind), p + (comb[a + 1][R] - comb[a][R]) * (comb[R + C][R] - comb[b][R]));
        dfsL(ind + 1, a, b + 1, mask, p - (comb[b + 1][R] - comb[b][R]) * (comb[R + C][R] - comb[a][R]));
    }

    static void dfsR(int ind, int a, int b, int mask, long p) {
        if (ind == C + 1) {
            dpR[a].add(new Pair(p, mask));
            return;
        }
        dfsR(ind + 1, a - 1, b, mask ^ (1 << ind), p + (comb[a][R] - comb[a - 1][R]) * (comb[R + C][R] - comb[b][R]));
        dfsR(ind + 1, a, b - 1, mask, p - (comb[b][R] - comb[b - 1][R]) * (comb[R + C][R] - comb[a][R]));
    }

    static long ans = 0;
    static long[][] dp = new long[31][31];

    static long rev(int x, int y) {
        int z = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < y; i++) {
            if (((x >> i) & 1) != 0) {
                z ^= 1 << (y - 1 - i);
            }
        }
        return z;
    }

    static long res = 0;

    static void check(long x, int t) {
        res++;
        int len = S.length();
        int aCount = 0, bCount = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 2 * C + 2; i++) {
            if (((x >> i) & 1) != 0) aCount++;
            else bCount++;
            if (aCount > 0 && bCount > 0) {
                for (int j = i; j < 2 * C + 2; j++) {
                    if (((x >> j) & 1) != 0) {
                        if (S.charAt(len - (2 * C + 2) + j) == 'B') return;
                    } else {
                        if (S.charAt(len - (2 * C + 2) + j) == 'A') return;
                    }
                }
                int aa = 0, bb = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < len - (2 * C + 2) + i; j++) {
                    if (S.charAt(j) == 'A') aa++;
                    if (S.charAt(j) == 'B') bb++;
                }
                long tmp = 0;
                if (((x >> i) & 1) != 0) {
                    tmp = comb[R - 1 - aa + bCount + R - 1 - bb][R - 1 - aa];
                } else {
                    tmp = comb[aCount + R - 1 - aa + R - 1 - bb][aCount + R - 1 - aa];
                }
                ans += t * tmp;
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean ok(long x) {
        int len = S.length();
        for (int i = 0; i <= C; i++) {
            if (((x >> i) & 1) != 0) {
                if (S.charAt(len - C - 1 + i) == 'B') return false;
            } else {
                if (S.charAt(len - C - 1 + i) == 'A') return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        init();
        for (int i = 0; i <= R - 1; i++) {
            dfsL(0, R - 1, R - 1, 0, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= R + C; i++) {
            dfsR(0, R + C, R + C, 0, 0);
        }

        long dif = INF;
        for (int i = 0; i <= R + C; i++) {
            Collections.sort(dpL[i], Comparator.comparingLong(p -> p.first));
            Collections.sort(dpR[i], Comparator.comparingLong(p -> p.first).reversed());
            int ind = 0;
            for (Pair t : dpL[i]) {
                while (ind + 1 < dpR[i].size() && t.first + dpR[i].get(ind + 1).first >= 0) ind++;
                dif = Math.min(dif, Math.abs(t.first + dpR[i].get(ind).first));
                if (ind + 1 < dpR[i].size()) {
                    dif = Math.min(dif, Math.abs(t.first + dpR[i].get(ind + 1).first));
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= R + C; i++) {
            List<Pair> z = new ArrayList<>();
            for (Pair t : dpR[i]) {
                if (match(rev((int) t.second, C + 1))) {
                    z.add(t);
                }
            }
            int l = 0, r = -1;
            for (Pair t : dpL[i]) {
                while (l < z.size() && t.first + z.get(l).first > dif) l++;
                while (r + 1 < z.size() && t.first + z.get(r + 1).first >= -dif) r++;
                if (l <= r) {
                    check(t.second | (rev((int) z.get(l).second, C + 1) << (C + 1)), r - l + 1);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
